verdict.rationale: Bugbot reviews every PR update automatically, can be triggered by PR comments like `bugbot run`, and accepts rules through `.cursor/BUGBOT.md`, org-wide Bugbot Automations, and natural-language effort policies. A user also describes switching auto reviews to request-only mode. These rules shape what the review does, not which arbitrary actions run on which events, and Bugbot Automations is barely documented. Missing for 10: general event-to-action rule definitions beyond PR review, documentation of what Bugbot Automations rules can trigger, and independent hands-on corroboration of custom rule-driven automation.
